persona: Purchase assistant at a manufacturer stepping up to procurement executive
resumeText:
Kavya Reddy | Hyderabad | kavya.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Purchase Assistant, Deccan Pumps and Valves, Hyderabad (2023 - present)
- Converted purchase requisitions from stores and maintenance into purchase orders.
- Raised and amended purchase orders in Oracle Purchasing for 120 active suppliers.
- Floated RFQs to four or five vendors and prepared comparative statements for approval.
- Developed six alternate vendors for castings and fasteners in the Hyderabad region.
- Tracked open purchase orders and supplier delivery dates in Excel and followed up on delays.

Stores Assistant, Charminar Engineering Works, Hyderabad (2022 - 2023)
- Issued materials to the shop floor and updated stock registers.

SKILLS
Negotiation, Excel, Oracle Purchasing, GST basics

EDUCATION
BCom, Osmania University, 2022
